title: Start Strong: Opening a Biology Research Presentation
objective: Students learn a clear opening that introduces topic, speaker, and research purpose.
context: You will speak about birds at a campus pond. Your talk will cover where you watched, what you saw and one question for next time.

items.prompt: Write a greeting and a title for your talk.
items.answer: Example: Good morning. My talk is called Birds at Our Campus Pond.

items.prompt: Say why you are giving the talk in one sentence.
items.answer: Example: I want to share what we learned about birds at the pond.
items.hint: Try: Today I want to show you ___.

items.prompt: Give a three-part plan. Say the full opening to a partner.
items.answer: Listen for the place, observations, and a question for next time in a clear order.
